topic: Solo mining versus mining pools explained
hook: Solo mining versus a pool: what's the difference?

scenes.narration: Your chance of finding a block is your share of the network's total hashrate.
Solo miners can wait a long time between rewards, then get a whole block at once.
Pools combine hashrate and share rewards in proportion to the work each member contributed.

cta: Want to dig deeper? There's a link on my channel page if you'd like to explore digital mining.
title: Solo Mining vs Mining Pools for Beginners
description_body: Why pools exist: your odds per block follow your share of network hashrate, and pools smooth out the payouts.
